subject: Monte Carlo SImulation for a fitted model using R-INLA

messages.author: 6f17ff4d1bfe11d7
messages.subject: Monte Carlo SImulation for a fitted model using R-INLA
parts:
Let's assume that I have a fitted model using R-INLA. This model has fitted for the human population. So, I need to simulate what will happen if the population increase or decreases by 10000. How can I use the Monte Carlo Simulation for this?  Any sample code for this is really helpful.

Thank you in advance.
